استطبقوا (form X)
# اِسْتَطْبَقُوا (istaṭbaqū) /is.tatˤ.ba.quː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَطْبَقَ (istaṭbaqa)
# اُسْتُطْبِقُوا (ustuṭbiqū) /us.tutˤ.bi.quː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَطْبَقَ (istaṭbaqa)
# اِسْتَطْبِقُوا (istaṭbiqū) /is.tatˤ.bi.quː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَطْبَقَ (istaṭbaqa)
